latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of financial-fraud-analyzer skill.

- Provides structured risk assessment of financial statement fraud using Beneish M-Score, Dechow F-Score, and cash-profit consistency.
- Supports both deep single-company analysis and rapid batch screening (10+ companies).
- Industry-adjusted risk thresholds and automated data fetching via SEC EDGAR API.
- Integrates three layers of evidence: model results, financial logic, and governance disclosures.
- Includes standardized output templates and quality checks to ensure clarity and transparency.
- Validated with real data from major US companies (AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, NVDA, etc.).
